Emily / Mark —

Great to meet you both on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Objective: Validate a 6-week pilot to measure inference latency, cost per 1M tokens, and data residency for MedTech’s anonymized claims workflows.
2) Success criteria (what your team said):
   - End-to-end 95th percentile latency < 400ms for interactive queries
   - Average cost under $0.25 per 1k tokens for production-like throughput
   - SOC2-compatible audit trail + DPA in place
3) Key stakeholders you mentioned:
   - Economic buyer: Mark Roberts (CFO) — responsible for final approval on pilot budget
   - Security/Privacy: Procurement/security procurement team (procurement@medsys.com) + internal InfoSec lead (TBD)
   - Legal: Standard MSA/DPA review by legal (TBD)

Immediate asks / proposed plan:
- Can you confirm Mark is the official economic buyer and whether we should prepare a one-page financial summary for him?
- Procurement needs an NDA before sharing the security checklist — we'll push our standard mutual NDA (attached).
- If you can share the name/email of the InfoSec reviewer we’ll loop them into the security questionnaire this week.

I’ve attached a 1-pager scope and our NDA for convenience. Proposed timeline: NDA turnaround ~2 business days, security questionnaire + evidence exchange 5-7 business days after NDA, MSA redline window 7-10 business days.

If that works, I’ll send the NDA to procurement and loop Jasmine (Legal onboarding) and Soojin (Security) as the internal owners.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
